Reviewer: m3 pool job review-4296, claude-fable-5-2, mkinney/team2; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blocking finding. This is a SAFETY-tier review: the PR changes a bound that the fixture collision laws read.

Review record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4296#issuecomment-7209724854

## What looks good

- The weight is correct. `angles_to_axis` (`crates/cl/src/cl/pose.rs:68`) gives the axis `Rz(C) (cos A sin B, -sin A, cos A cos B)`. The derivative norm is 1 for A, `|cos A|` for B and at most 1 for C. The axis speed is thus not more than `|A'| + |cos A| |B'| + |C'|`.
- `max_abs_cos` (`crates/sim/src/verify/midpose.rs:164`) takes the largest `|cos A|` of the whole move. That is not less than the largest value in each interval. The bound stays an upper bound.
- I read each reader of `Interval::swing`:
  - `posed_steel.rs:195` and `:279`, `mesh_posed.rs:266`, `avoid.rs:181` use the swing as an axis angle. The new bound is sufficient for them.
  - `posed_steel.rs:186` and `mesh_posed.rs:156` use the swing as a floor for the rotary turn `dth`. `upright_turn` (`posed_steel.rs:306`) gives a turn only for a pose in the plane normal to the rotary line. There the rotary turns as fast as the pose. The new bound is sufficient there too.
- The fix is physically correct. A machine with one rotary A does not move when the pose letters go from B180 to B0 at A -90.
- The decision file is present. The PR adds no dependency, no process file and no UI change. The two files stay below 400 lines (266 and 248).

## Results, trial-merged with main

Built locally on host m3 (macOS). Trial merge of head `a5b1958eb` with `upstream/main` `9b141e112`: clean, no conflict.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-sim --lib` | 283 passed, 0 failed |
| Pin `verify::posed_steel::tests::a_b_flip_at_the_pole_of_a_turning_a_does_not_swing_the_housing_into_the_table` | pass |
| Pin `verify::midpose::tests::the_cos_a_weighted_bound_holds_near_the_pole` | pass |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 135 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled |
| `app suites: example_catalog` (in the quick plan) | 44 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | 6 steps, 0 failed |
| Heavy lanes | not run. This is a `P3` PR. "Heavy lanes at review" gives it no heavy step. |

Extra suites run: none. The diff changes no file under `testdata/`, no fixture, no golden and no importer code.

## Mutations (run by the reviewer)

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| 1. The old rate line (each letter at full weight) | RED. The two pinning tests fail. `left: Hit(Spindle) right: Clear` ("machine frame, pose [0.0, 1.0, 1e-9]"), and the assert at `midpose.rs:246`. |
| 2. The B weight forced to 0 (an under-report) | GREEN. All 283 tests of the `camcraft-sim` lib pass. This agrees with the PR body. |
| Fix restored | GREEN |

Reviewer probe (a temporary test, not committed): 20 000 random letter pairs, half of them within 12 degrees of the pole, 200 samples for each pair. The measured axis speed was never more than the weighted rate. The largest ratio was 0.99996, so the bound is tight and correct. I also checked `max_abs_cos` against known values: (-89, -80), (-10, 10), (170, 190), (-90, -90), (60, 85), (0, 0). All agree.

## Goldens moved

None. The diff has three files: `midpose.rs`, `posed_steel_tests.rs` and the decision file. No `*.nc`, `*.cl` or `examples/catalog/**` file changed. The body says the same.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Follow-ups (file after merge)

1. **No test fails when the B weight under-reports** (suggested `P7`, `area:sim`, `effort:low`). Mutation 2 stays green. The end poses of each interval hide the letter-rate term in the current tests. Add a direct test of `max_abs_cos` (`midpose.rs:164`) with known values, and a speed test: the measured axis speed along the lerp is not more than the weighted rate. The reviewer probe above shows that such a test is small. Then a later wrong edit of the weight goes red.
2. **The reporter's project is not exercised** (note for the merging session). The body says this plainly. The pin gives the reported verdict (`Hit(Spindle)` against the table) at the sim law, and it is red on the old bound. But the post of the reporter's project is not shown before and after. A B flip with a real turn (for example A -89, B 180 -> 0) leaves the plane of the rotary. It reads `Unjudged` before and after this PR. If the reporter still sees the refusal in a build with this fix, reopen #4262 ("User-reported bugs reopen, never re-file").

## Optional, non-blocking

- `midpose.rs:163`: the comment says "Non-finite reads as 1". That is not true for one NaN argument: `f64::min` and `f64::max` drop a NaN, so `max_abs_cos(NaN, 3.0)` gives `cos 3` and not 1. There is no effect on a verdict: a NaN A letter makes the A term of `rate` NaN, and the swing fails closed. Test `a0` and `a1` for finite values before the `min` / `max`, or correct the comment.
- The body does not use the "Reproduction before fix" structure of the `repro-first` skill (baseline SHA, command). The red reading is there. No action is necessary for this PR.
- #4297 tracks the message that does not name the struck box. It is open (`P7`).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
